contexts.text: Not imputed to him who has not done it with deliberate intention.

The free state of their deliberation. Signified. In both cases there is required a free state of deliberation; in betrothal and marriage... and also in the initiation and conjunction of good and truth. Explained.
Little children... have nothing purposed and deliberate, thus no end of evil.
Then followed a deliberation about the Holy Spirit. TCR 188:7.
The woman ought to consult her parents... and afterwards deliberate with herself, before she consents. General article.
This signified that they were determined by such a phantasy.
Another also deliberated in like manner from herself, and was made like a pendulous ghost.
On the Hell of those who... act with deliberation and circumspection.
